best_practice_cues.name: Turn 1
cues: Inconsistent line — pick ONE reference (brake marker, apex kerb, exit point) and repeat it every lap.
Apex speed varies lap-to-lap — commit to a repeatable minimum speed; trail-brake smoothly to the apex rather than braking different amounts each lap.
Braking point wanders — use a fixed visual brake marker.

honesty_notes.lookahead: head-ORIENTATION (AirPods yaw) proxy for gaze, approximate.
honesty_notes.rpm: engine RPM not reliably recoverable from this audio; excluded.
honesty_notes.line_spread: apex-position scatter (m); dominated by ~3.5m GPS noise, so used only as a soft secondary signal - the consistency score is driven mainly by repeatable APEX SPEED.
honesty_notes.incidents: incident laps = significantly slower laps (>5% off best, i.e. spins / big time loss); excluded from consistency. Impact g-events (kerb strikes, the hairpin wall hit) are reported as LOCATIONS, not used to invalidate laps.
